description: A chessboard sits on the table with yellow pieces lined up on one side, and there are clear plastic bags off to the left. The left hand picks up a clear bag and holds it open as a left-hand object while the right hand removes pieces from the board, lifting them up and dropping them into the bag; after clearing one side, both hands rotate and slide the board to reorient it, then the left hand opens another bag and the right hand gathers the remaining yellow pieces into it before the left hand moves the filled bag aside.
